prompt: Talk about your first job, explaining what the job was, what specific tasks you were responsible for, and why the experience was challenging for you.
sample:
Hello,

My first real job was at a busy movie theatre in my hometown when I was sixteen. I worked there part-time on weekends for about a year. It was my first experience earning my own money, so I was both excited and a little nervous.

I was responsible for two main things: selling tickets at the box office and serving popcorn at the concession stand. The most challenging part was definitely the Friday night rush. It became incredibly busy, and I had to handle long lines of customers all by myself. I remember feeling stressed because I had to manage cash quickly and accurately while people were waiting.

That experience taught me so much about responsibility and how to provide good customer service. I learned to stay calm under pressure and be more organized. After that, I felt much more confident. So even though it was tough, it was a valuable first step into the working world.
